svg.title: 4-PIN STEPPER IDLE VALVE + TPS

svg.text: BIG BRICK ECU / TWO H-BRIDGES + A SEPARATE ANALOG TPS
3 pins · analog voltage, 5 V, sensor ground
D–C = COIL A / B–A = COIL B · VERIFY WINDING PAIRS
USES BOTH H-BRIDGES — ELECTRONIC THROTTLE NOT AVAILABLE SIMULTANEOUSLY
Check actual idle-valve coil pairs and TPS plug terminal order before wiring.
GM O-RING EXAMPLE — VIEW INTO VALVE: D C B A (CHECK KEYING)
